intro: Ferocitas the Dream Eater is an Alliance quest given by Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar. After recovering his damaged heirloom dreamcatcher, Tallonkai discovers its potent emerald core was pried away by Gnarlpine furbolgs north of Starbreeze Village. Adventurers are sent to slay the corrupted mystics and recover the stolen jewel from their leader, Ferocitas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

There is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.
Find this missing jewel, friend. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine. Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher. Thank you, friend.
